summary: Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv overnight, igniting fires in three districts including a residential high-rise, while a camera-equipped Geran-4 drone attacked a Chernihiv supermarket killing two civilians including a child. Simultaneously, Russian forces launched at least seven Shahed drones and Onyx missiles against Odesa region, and Ukrainian UAVs set fire to a Russian military train in occupied territory. Romania reported three Russian UAV incursions prompting a diplomatic protest, Iran accused Ukraine of a Caspian Sea ship attack, and Bloomberg highlighted multi-year delays in licensed Patriot missile production for Ukraine.
key_points: Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv overnight, igniting fires in Shevchenkivskyi, Desnianskyi, and Solomianskyi districts with no reported casualties. (Source: @UkraineNow/82933)
Russian "Geran-4" drone equipped with a video camera attacked an ATB supermarket in Chernihiv, killing two including a child and injuring 13. (Source: @UkraineNow/82943)
Russian forces launched at least seven Shahed drones overnight, with two targeting Zatoka in Odesa region and one heading toward Slavutych in Chernihiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69410)
Russian Onyx missiles struck Odesa and Chornomorsk, while a "Banderol" rocket hit Poltava. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69408, @mon1tor_ua/69405)
Ukrainian UAV strike set fire to tank cars on a Russian military train in occupied territory. (Source: @eRadarrua/102783)
Russian guided aerial bombs (KABs) targeted northern Kharkiv region and Donetsk region toward Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @kpszsu/70229)
Romania prepares diplomatic protest after at least three unauthorized Russian UAVs entered its airspace over three days. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31930)
Bloomberg reports licensed Patriot missile production in Germany not yet started after three years, delaying Ukraine's air defense capabilities. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31936)
